title: Beef Bourguignon Casserole
description: A hearty French beef casserole with tender beef and vegetables in a rich red wine sauce.
instructions: Season the beef with salt and pepper.
In a large pan over medium-high heat, sear the beef until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pan and set aside.
Add the chopped onion, sliced carrot, and chopped celery to the pan and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushroom and cook until the mushroom is tender, about 3 minutes.
Add the crushed tomato, red wine, beef broth, thyme, and bay leaves to the pan and stir to combine.
Return the beef to the pan and bring the mixture to a boil.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch casserole dish.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes.
Serve the casserole hot, garnished with pearl onions and fresh thyme.
